verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares documents first-party scenario modeling that lets you explore hypothetical future rounds and export scenarios for review, with IRR and cash-on-cash outputs. It also says you can model your next round and generate a term sheet, and scenario modeling is listed as a plan feature. However, the evidence never names the specific mechanics in the story, and sharing is described only as exporting 'to review with your team'. Convertible note generation exists, but that is issuing instruments, not modeling their conversion. missing for 10: explicit option pool top-up modeling, SAFE/convertible conversion in a priced round, pro-forma ownership/dilution tables, direct sharing of scenarios with counsel and investors, independent or hands-on corroboration.
